name: simple_calendar_pro_get_event_titles
intent: Look up events at a specific date and time in Simple Calendar Pro
description: Opens Simple Calendar Pro, navigates to the requested date, and returns the titles of events scheduled at the requested time.
patterns: What is on my schedule on that date at that time?
What event do I have at that time?
Show my calendar event titles for that date and time

inputs.name: schedule_time
inputs.description: The time to check on that date.

steps.intent: Navigate to {{schedule_date}} and view its events to find those at {{schedule_time}}
